source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: يوم من الأيام، رحت عالمكتبة أدور على كتاب.
sentences.en: One day, I went to the library to look for a book.
The library was big and quiet.

sentences.ar: الرفوف كانت مليانة كتب من كل نوع.
sentences.en: The shelves were full of books of every kind.

sentences.ar: مشيت بين الرفوف وقريت عناوين كتير.
sentences.en: I walked between the shelves and read many titles.

sentences.ar: لقيت كتاب قصص قديمة وقعدت أتصفحه.
sentences.en: I found a book of old stories and sat leafing through it.

sentences.ar: الوقت مر وأنا ما حسيت فيه.
sentences.en: Time passed and I didn't feel it.

sentences.ar: الموظفة قالت إنه المكتبة رح تسكر.
sentences.en: The employee said the library was about to close.
I borrowed the book and left.
On the way, I was excited to start reading it.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صرت أروح عالمكتبة كل أسبوع.
sentences.en: Since that day, I started going to the library every week.
